## Combo 11-223-1367-2881-4289
Cards: Kalamax, the Stormsire + Nexus of Fate + Merchant Scroll + Narset's Reversal + Cryptolith Rite

  Resolve Kalamax's second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
   Resolve the copy of Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one.
  Resolve the Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one.
  Pass to next turn.
  Activate Kalamax by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
  Cast Merchant Scroll by paying {1}{U}.
  Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Merchant Scroll.
  Kalamax first and second abilities triggers.
  Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the first Narset's Reversal.
  Resolve Kalamax's second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.

  Repeat.

  Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Fork targeting the original Fork.
  Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
  Resolve the Fork copy, creating a copy of Fork, targeting the original Fork.
  Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
  Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
  Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Fork copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
  Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

## Combo 248-465-1916
Cards: Changeling Berserker + Wormfang Drake + Changeling Titan
Color identity: GUR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 9 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control); Llanowar Scout (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Izzet Boilerworks (hand)
Prerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
Steps: Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
  Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
  Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
  Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
  Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Repeat each combat phase.

Color identity: GUR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Phantom Steed (battlefield); Godo, Bandit Warlord (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (exile: exiled by Phantom Steed); Arcane Adaptation (battlefield); Concordant Crossroads (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
Steps: Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
  Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.

## Combo 465-1916-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Wormfang Drake + Changeling Titan
Color identity: GUR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
  When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
  Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
  Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
  Repeat from step 4.

## Combo 804-1704-2757--231
Cards: Krark, the Thumbless + Earthcraft + Sakashima the Impostor
Color identity: GUR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite copies of creatures you control; Infinite copies of instant or sorcery spells you cast; Infinite untap of basic lands you control; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count
Requires: Instant or Sorcery that Creates One or More Nonlegendary Copies of a Creature You Control (hand)
Start: Krark, the Thumbless (battlefield); Earthcraft (battlefield); Sakashima the Impostor (battlefield: as a copy of Krark)
Prerequisites: You control a basic land.
  This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
Steps: Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untapping a basic land.
  Activate that basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
  Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
  Cast the instant or sorcery that creates a copy of a creature by paying its mana cost, targeting Sakashima the Impostor.
  When you cast that spell, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
  Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning the original to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
  Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
  If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
  If you won every flip, instead resolve the card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
  If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before the copying spell ends up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
  Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.
